items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Conron, I don't know, I think that's an Albert System we had, the clarinet.

ctx.x: And let's see, this picture here, this band is, is that one that you were in or your father? No, my father. That's my father here. Oh, the one sitting in the middle of the sax, alto sax. Yeah, and the clarinet. That's my father. And the clarinet. Yes, I see he has the clarinet standing there. I can't see the picture, it's a little bit dim. Did he play Albert System or Bane System? I think that was a C.G.
Conron, I don't know, I think that's an Albert System we had, the clarinet.
